name: com.kaspalinks/kaspa-links
title: Kaspa Links
description: Prepare Kaspa payment links, claim links and on-chain giveaways, and list open giveaways.

tools.name: prepare_payment_link
tools.description: Prepare a Kaspa payment link that pays straight into the user's own Kaspa wallet: tips or donations (payers choose the amount), a fixed price, or a fundraising goal with a progress bar. Returns a prefilled kaspalinks.com form; the user opens it, checks the address and creates the link. No account and no platform fee. Ask the user for their own kaspa: address if they have not given it; never guess one.

amount_kas.description: Required for kind fixed (the price) and goal (the target), in KAS, for example "25" or "12.5". At least 0.2 KAS. Ignored for kind any.

kind.description: any: payers choose how much (tips, donations). fixed: a set price (invoice, sale). goal: collect toward a target with a progress bar.

recipient_address.description: The user's own Kaspa mainnet address that receives the payments (kaspa:…).

title.description: Short title payers see, for example "Buy me a coffee".

tools.name: prepare_claim_link
tools.description: Prepare a claim link: a way to send KAS to someone without knowing their address. The user pays the amount once into a one-time on-chain output; whoever opens the link claims it to their own wallet; if nobody claims it within the claim window, the KAS returns to the user's wallet by itself. A count of 2 to 8 makes a Claim Drop with that many separate links (needs a free Kaspa Links profile). Returns the kaspalinks.com form to open.

count.description: How many separate claim links, 1 to 8.

tools.name: prepare_giveaway
tools.description: Prepare an on-chain giveaway, for example for a community or Telegram group. The prize is locked in a SilverScript contract on Kaspa with the creator's return wallet; entries are recorded on-chain and free for entrants, who only need a Kaspa address; a later Kaspa block picks the winner and the contract pays only that winner. If nobody enters, the prize goes back. Kaspa Links never holds the prize. Returns the kaspalinks.com studio to open.

tools.name: list_open_giveaways
tools.description: List open on-chain Kaspa giveaways on Kaspa Links that anyone can enter for free with a Kaspa address: prize, entries, free spots, closing time and the page to enter.
